Class KWayTransitionCoverEQOracle<A extends DeterministicAutomaton.RegularAutomaton<?,I,?> & Output<I,D>,I,D>

Type Parameters:
A - automaton type

All Implemented Interfaces:
EquivalenceOracle<A,I,D>, TestWordGenerator<A,I>
public class KWayTransitionCoverEQOracle<A extends DeterministicAutomaton.RegularAutomaton<?,I,?> & Output<I,D>,I,D> extends AbstractTestWordEQOracle<A,I,D>
An EquivalenceOracle based on the concepts of mutation testing as described in the paper Learning from Faults: Mutation Testing in Active Automata Learning by Bernhard K. Aichernig and Martin Tappler.

This Equivalence oracle selects test cases based on k-way transitions coverage. It does that by generating random queries and finding the smallest subset with the highest coverage. In other words, this oracle finds counter examples by running random paths that cover all pairwise / k-way transitions.

Implementation detail: Note that this test generator heavily relies on the sampling of states. If the given automaton has very few or very many states, the number of generated test cases may be very low or high, respectively. As a result, it may be advisable to combine this generator with other generators or limit the number of generated test cases.

      public KWayTransitionCoverEQOracle(MembershipOracle<I,D> oracle, Random random, int randomWalkLen, int numGeneratePaths, int maxPathLen, int maxNumberOfSteps, int k, KWayTransitionCoverTestsIterator.OptimizationMetric optimizationMetric, KWayTransitionCoverTestsIterator.GenerationMethod generationMethod, int batchSize)
      Constructor.
      Parameters:
      oracle - the oracle for accessing the system under learning
      random - the random number generator to use
      randomWalkLen - the number of steps that are added by prefix-generated paths
      numGeneratePaths - number of randomly-generated queries used to find the optimal subset
      maxPathLen - the maximum step size of randomly-generated queries
      maxNumberOfSteps - threshold for the number of steps after which no more new test words will be generated (a value less than zero means no limit)
      k - k value used for K-Way transitions, i.e the number of steps between the start and the end of a transition
      optimizationMetric - the metric after which test queries are minimized
      generationMethod - defines how the queries are generated
      batchSize - size of the batches sent to the membership oracle
